subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts — P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Exercise keeps the body fit and active.

P: It also boosts mental health.

Q: Regular workouts reduce stress levels.

R: Walking, cycling, and yoga are easy options.

S: Physical activity strengthens the heart and muscles.

6. So, exercise should be part of our routine.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

 
• The given passage discusses the importance of exercise and its benefits for physical and mental health. 
 
• **Sentence S** is the first sentence of the sequence as it introduces the benefit of physical activity, specifically strengthening the heart and muscles:
 
 
• "Physical activity strengthens the heart and muscles."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P** follows because it expands on the benefits of exercise by mentioning its impact on mental health:
 
 
• "It also boosts mental health."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R** comes next as it provides examples of easy exercise options:
 
 
• "Walking, cycling, and yoga are easy options."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q** concludes the sequence as it highlights how regular workouts can reduce stress levels:
 
 
• "Regular workouts reduce stress levels."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **SPRQ**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Exercise keeps the body fit and active. Physical activity strengthens the heart and muscles. It also boosts mental health. Walking, cycling, and yoga are easy options. Regular workouts reduce stress levels. So, exercise should be part of our routine."
